title: Eric Walker interview: 'What do you know about ESP?' and the control group

tellings.quote: stuff. And he cuts the guy off. He said, "Look, let me ask you a question. What do you know about ESP?" And the guy had no answer. He said, "Look, unless you understand about ESP and how it works, you will not be taken in by the control group. Very few people understand how it works."

plain: In a 1987 phone interview, a man named Eric A. Walker, whom the researcher Grant Cameron calls the head of the whole UFO program, is said to have cut off the person questioning him and asked, 'What do you know about ESP?' Cameron, who tells Michels about the interview from its transcripts, says the questioner had no answer, and Walker told him that 'unless you understand about ESP and how it works, you will not be taken in by the control group,' meaning the group he said ran the secret, adding that 'very few people understand how it works.' If true, it would mean psychic ability was a condition for getting inside.
